source_context: Bulk sandbox historical replay evidence pilot v0.2. Synthetic seed evidence for attribution-learning pipeline testing; not production evidence.
evidence_items: Singapore Precision Engineering output in 2019 was shaped by machinery demand, capital equipment demand, and industrial equipment demand.
Equipment orders, automation equipment, and semiconductor equipment demand affected engineering output.
Capital spending, investment demand, and the capex cycle influenced precision engineering activity.
Manufacturing customers adjusted orders as global demand and production cycles changed.
